name: Pasquale Tridico - § 30 - Am 2
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section II – European Council and Council
part_text: 30. Stresses that unanimity voting remains a core principle of the Treaties and acts as a safeguard to national sovereignty in sensitive policy areas; highlights that its use constitutes a legitimate expression of democratic accountability by Member States’ governments towards their national parliaments and citizens; underlines that any debate on decision-making efficiency must fully respect the Treaties and cannot undermine the principle of conferral between the Union and its Member States;
